035    public synchronized void init(Context context, String cacheDir)// List<Typeface> fonts, List<String> xml

040                _cacheDir = cacheDir;

043                FontManager.getInstance().init(context, cacheDir);
044
045                UnitDefTable.getInstance().init(context);
046                UnitFontLookup.getInstance().init(context);
047                SymbolDefTable.getInstance().init(context);
048                SinglePointLookup.getInstance().init(context);
049                TacticalGraphicLookup.getInstance().init(context);
050
051                // PROTOTYPE SVG////////////////////////////////////////
052                // works, but half speed
053                /*
054                 * String USVG = getXML("unitfontsvg.svg"); UnitSVGTable.getInstance().init(USVG); String
055                 * SPSVG = getXML("singlepointsvg.svg"); SymbolSVGTable.getInstance().init(SPSVG);//
056                 */
057                //////////////////////////////////////////////////////
058
059                // setup single point renderer
060                _SPR = SinglePointRenderer.getInstance();
061                // _SPSVGR = SinglePointSVGRenderer.getInstance();
062
063                _initSucces.set(true);
064            }
065
066        } catch (Exception exc) {
067            Log.e(TAG, exc.getMessage(), exc);
068        }
069    }

076    // @Override
077    public Boolean CanRender(String symbolID, SparseArray<String> modifiers, SparseArray<String> attributes)
078    {
079
080        String message = null;
081        String basicSymbolID = symbolID;
082        basicSymbolID = SymbolUtilities.getBasicSymbolID(basicSymbolID);
083        // ErrorLogger.LogMessage("TEST");
084
085        int symStd = -1;
086        String temp;
087        if (attributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.SymbologyStandard) >= 0) {
088            temp = attributes.get(MilStdAttributes.SymbologyStandard);
089            if (SymbolUtilities.isNumber(temp)) {
090                symStd = Integer.parseInt(temp);
091            }
092        }
093
094        if (symStd < 0 || symStd > RendererSettings.Symbology_2525C) {
095            symStd = RendererSettings.getInstance().getSymbologyStandard();
096        }
097
098        try {
099            // message = "Cannot draw: " + symbolCode + " (" + basicSymbolID + ")";
100            SymbolDefTable sdt = SymbolDefTable.getInstance();
101            if (SymbolUtilities.isTacticalGraphic(basicSymbolID)) {
102
103                SymbolDef sd = sdt.getSymbolDef(basicSymbolID, symStd);
104                if (sd != null) {
105
106                    if (sd.getDrawCategory() == 8)// make sure we can find the character in the font.
107                    {
108                        int index = -1;
109                        index = SinglePointLookup.getInstance().getCharCodeFromSymbol(symbolID, symStd);
110                        if (index > 0) {
111                            return true;
112                        } else {
113                            message = "Bad font lookup for: " + symbolID + " (" + basicSymbolID + ")";
114                        }
115                    } else // check with icon renderer for multipoints
116                    {
117                        message = "Cannot draw: " + symbolID + " (" + basicSymbolID + ")";
118                    }
119
120                } else {
121                    message = "Cannot draw symbolID: " + symbolID + " (" + basicSymbolID + ")";
122                }
123            } else {
124                UnitDef ud = UnitDefTable.getInstance().getUnitDef(basicSymbolID, symStd);
125                // UnitFontLookupInfo ufli = UnitFontLookup.getInstance().getLookupInfo(basicSymbolID,symStd);
126                if (ud != null) {
127                    return true;
128                } else {
129                    message = "JavaRenderer.CanRender() - Cannot draw symbolID: " + symbolID + " ("
130                            + basicSymbolID + ")";
131                }
132            }
133
134            if (message != null && !message.equals("")) {
135                ErrorLogger.LogMessage(this.getClass().getName(), "CanRender()", message, Level.FINE);
136                // System.err.println(message);
137                // System.out.println("");
138                // System.out.println("INFO: CanRender - " + message);
139                // Exception foo = new Exception("Stack?");
140                // foo.printStackTrace();
141            }
142        } catch (Exception exc) {
143            ErrorLogger.LogException("MilStdIconRenderer", "CanRender", exc);
144        }
145        return false;
146    }
147
148    private ImageInfo renderTacticalMultipointIcon(String symbolID, SparseArray<String> attributes)
149    {
150        Color lineColor = SymbolUtilities.getLineColorOfAffiliation(symbolID);
151        if (attributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.LineColor) >= 0) {
152            lineColor = new Color(attributes.get(MilStdAttributes.LineColor));
153        }
154        int size = RendererSettings.getInstance().getDefaultPixelSize();// 35;
155        if (attributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.PixelSize) >= 0) {
156            size = Integer.parseInt(attributes.get(MilStdAttributes.PixelSize));
157        }
158
159        int symStd = RendererSettings.getInstance().getSymbologyStandard();
160        if (attributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.SymbologyStandard) >= 0) {
161            symStd = Integer.parseInt(attributes.get(MilStdAttributes.SymbologyStandard));
162        }
163
164        int outlineWidth = RendererSettings.getInstance().getSinglePointSymbolOutlineWidth();
165        boolean asIcon = false;
166        Color outlineColor = null;
167        if (attributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.DrawAsIcon) >= 0) {
168            asIcon = Boolean.getBoolean(attributes.get(MilStdAttributes.SymbologyStandard));
169            if(asIcon)
170                outlineWidth = 0;
171        }
172        outlineColor = RendererUtilities.getIdealOutlineColor(lineColor);
173        ImageInfo ii = TacticalGraphicIconRenderer.getIcon(symbolID, size, lineColor, symStd, outlineWidth, outlineColor);
174        return ii;
175    }
176
177    // @Override
178    public ImageInfo RenderIcon(String symbolID, SparseArray<String> modifiers,
179            SparseArray<String> attributes)
180    {
181
182        int symStd = 1;
183
184        if (attributes != null && attributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.SymbologyStandard) >= 0) {
185            symStd = Integer.parseInt(attributes.get(MilStdAttributes.SymbologyStandard));
186        }
187
188        ImageInfo temp = null;
189        if (SymbolUtilities.isTacticalGraphic(symbolID)) {
190            String basicSymbolID = SymbolUtilities.getBasicSymbolIDStrict(symbolID);
191            SymbolDef sd = SymbolDefTable.getInstance().getSymbolDef(basicSymbolID, symStd);
192            if (sd == null) {
193                symbolID = SymbolUtilities.reconcileSymbolID(symbolID);
194                basicSymbolID = SymbolUtilities.getBasicSymbolIDStrict(symbolID);
195                sd = SymbolDefTable.getInstance().getSymbolDef(basicSymbolID, symStd);
196            }
197
198            if (sd != null) {
199                if (sd.getDrawCategory() == SymbolDef.DRAW_CATEGORY_POINT) {
200                    temp = _SPR.RenderSP(symbolID, modifiers, attributes);
201                } else {
202                    return renderTacticalMultipointIcon(symbolID, attributes);
203                }
204            } else {
205                temp = _SPR.RenderUnit(symbolID, modifiers, attributes);
206            }
207
208        } else {
209            temp = _SPR.RenderUnit(symbolID, modifiers, attributes);
210            /*
211             * if(RendererSettings.getInstance().getIconEngine() == RendererSettings.IconEngine_FONT) { temp =
212             * _SPR.RenderUnit(symbolID, modifiers, attributes); } else { temp = _SPSVGR.RenderUnit(symbolID,
213             * modifiers,attributes); }//
214             */
215
216        }
217
218        return temp;
219    }

228    private SparseArray<String> getDefaultAttributes(String symbolID)
229    {
230        SparseArray<String> map = new SparseArray<String>();
231        try {
232            if (symbolID == null || symbolID.length() != 15) {
233                if (symbolID == null) {
234                    symbolID = "null";
235                }
236                ErrorLogger.LogMessage("MilStdIconRenderer", "getDefaultAttributes",
237                        "getDefaultAttributes passed bad symbolID: " + symbolID);
238                return null;
239            }
240
241            map.put(MilStdAttributes.Alpha, "1.0");
242            if (SymbolUtilities.hasDefaultFill(symbolID)) {
243                map.put(MilStdAttributes.FillColor,
244                        SymbolUtilities.getFillColorOfAffiliation(symbolID).toHexString());
245            }
246
247            map.put(MilStdAttributes.LineColor,
248                    SymbolUtilities.getLineColorOfAffiliation(symbolID).toHexString());
249
250            map.put(MilStdAttributes.OutlineSymbol, "false");
251            // attribute[MilStdAttributes.SymbolOutlineColor] = null;
252            // map.put(MilStdAttributes.OutlineWidth,"1");
253
254            map.put(MilStdAttributes.DrawAsIcon, "false");
255
256            RendererSettings rs = RendererSettings.getInstance();
257
258            if (SymbolUtilities.isWarfighting(symbolID)) {
259                if (rs != null) {
260                    map.put(MilStdAttributes.FontSize, String.valueOf(rs.getUnitFontSize()));// 50;
261                } else {
262                    map.put(MilStdAttributes.FontSize, "50");// 50;
263                }
264                map.put(MilStdAttributes.PixelSize, "-1");
265            } else {
266                if (rs != null) {
267                    map.put(MilStdAttributes.FontSize, String.valueOf(rs.getSPFontSize()));// 60;
268                } else {
269                    map.put(MilStdAttributes.FontSize, "60");
270                }
271
272                map.put(MilStdAttributes.PixelSize, "-1");
273            }
274            map.put(MilStdAttributes.KeepUnitRatio, "true");
275            return map;
276        } catch (Exception exc) {
277            ErrorLogger.LogException("MilStdIconRenderer", "getDefaultAttributes", exc);
278        }
279        return map;
280    }
